monkey_king_mischief.name: Mischief
monkey_king_mischief.description: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for %invul_duration% seconds upon transforming.
monkey_king_mischief.lore: When you never know where danger will come from.

monkey_king_boundless_strike.name: Boundless Strike
monkey_king_boundless_strike.description: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.
monkey_king_boundless_strike.lore: The legendary staff Jingu Bang grows at its master’s will, ensuring enemies cannot escape its grasp.
monkey_king_boundless_strike.shard_description: Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with %spring_channel_pct%%% of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the end of his staff.

monkey_king_tree_dance.name: Tree Dance
monkey_king_tree_dance.description: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
monkey_king_tree_dance.facet_monkey_king_simian_stride: Increases the max level of Tree Dance. Level %max_level% Tree Dance reduces the cooldown to zero.
monkey_king_tree_dance.lore: Sun Wukong nimbly leaps through the forest canopy, staying out of reach no matter what.
monkey_king_tree_dance.note0: The cooldown of this ability begins upon landing.
monkey_king_tree_dance.note1: You can dismount from the tree by issuing a move command.
monkey_king_tree_dance.note2: Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.
monkey_king_tree_dance.abilitydraft_note: For Ability Draft only, Tree Dance ability swaps with Primal Spring while you are perched on a tree. You can no longer jump to other trees without returning to the ground first.

monkey_king_primal_spring.name: Primal Spring
monkey_king_primal_spring.description: CHANNELED - Monkey King springs out from his tree perch, damaging and slowing enemies in the area where he lands. Damage and slow amounts are in proportion to channel duration.
monkey_king_primal_spring.lore: Leaping from concealment into the midst of his enemies, Sun Wukong strikes without mercy.

monkey_king_jingu_mastery.name: Jingu Mastery
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.description: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns %charges% charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.lore: Sensitive to its master’s spirit, Jingu Bang shines with power when Sun Wukong shows his battle fervor.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.note0: A hit with Boundless Strike also increments the attack counter.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.note1: The effect on an enemy is refreshed with each attack.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.note2: The attack counter on an enemy cannot be dispelled.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.note3: The effect that grants the owner empowered attacks can be dispelled.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.note4: Gaining new effects is disabled by Break.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.note5: Existing effects are not removed by Break.

monkey_king_mischief.name: Mischief
monkey_king_mischief.description: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for %invul_duration% seconds upon transforming.
monkey_king_mischief.lore: When you never know where danger will come from.

monkey_king_wukongs_command.name: Wukong's Command
monkey_king_wukongs_command.description:
Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of %attack_speed%s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.

Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.facet_monkey_king_wukongs_faithful: Monkey King's soldiers last longer and do not disperse unless he spends more than %leadership_time_buffer% seconds outside the area.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.facet_monkey_king_transfiguration: Grants the Changing of the Guard ability during Wukong's Command.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.scepter_description: Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.lore: Sun Wukong plucks a tuft of fur and blows it at his enemies, turning each hair into a copy of himself.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.note0: Soldiers do not benefit from Jingu Mastery.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.note1: Soldier attacks do not trigger Skull Basher or Abyssal Blade effects.
